column1: perfect|v.|To improve something until it is as good as possible.|完善；使尽可能完美。|She practiced every day to perfect her technique.|她每天练习，以完善自己的技术。|musician practicing violin
shrewd|adj.|Good at understanding situations and making practical decisions.|精明的；善于判断的。|A shrewd buyer compares prices before making a decision.|精明的买家会在作决定前比较价格。|shopping market customer
jury|n.|A group of people who decide the facts of a case in court.|陪审团；在法庭上裁定案件事实的一组人。|The jury listened carefully to the evidence.|陪审团认真听取了证据。|courtroom jury
prohibit|v.|To officially forbid an action.|正式禁止某种行为。|The rules prohibit smoking inside the building.|规定禁止在楼内吸烟。|no smoking sign
criticism|n.|Comments that express disapproval or point out faults.|批评；指出缺点或表示不赞同的意见。|The plan faced criticism because it ignored local needs.|这项计划因忽视当地需求而受到批评。|public meeting discussion
compensation|n.|Money paid for work, loss, or injury.|报酬；对劳动、损失或伤害的金钱补偿。|The company offered compensation for the extra hours of work.|公司为额外的工作时间提供了报酬。|worker office payment
recession|n.|A period when economic activity falls.|经济衰退；经济活动下降的时期。|Many small businesses closed during the recession.|许多小企业在经济衰退期间倒闭了。|closed shop economic recession
delivery|n.|The act of bringing goods or messages to someone.|投递；递送货物或信息。|The delivery of fresh food takes place every morning.|新鲜食品每天早晨配送。|delivery bicycle food
prosperity|n.|The condition of being successful and having enough money.|繁荣；经济上成功和富足的状态。|Education can contribute to a country's prosperity.|教育可以促进一个国家的繁荣。|city market business
restraint|n.|Control that prevents excessive action or emotion.|克制；对行为或情绪的控制。|The speaker showed restraint despite the angry comments.|面对愤怒的评论，发言人仍保持克制。|meeting discussion speaker
pervasive|adj.|Present or noticeable throughout a place or society.|普遍的；遍布某处或某个社会的。|Digital technology has a pervasive influence on daily life.|数字技术对日常生活有广泛影响。|city smartphone technology
amplify|v.|To make a sound, effect, or problem stronger.|增强；放大声音、影响或问题。|Social media can amplify a small disagreement.|社交媒体可能放大一个小小的分歧。|social media mobile phone
patent|n.|A legal right that protects an invention.|专利；保护发明的法律权利。|The researcher applied for a patent for the new device.|研究者为这个新装置申请了专利。|inventor laboratory device
isolate|v.|To separate something so that it can be examined.|分离；将某物单独分开以便研究。|Scientists isolate the molecule before testing it.|科学家在测试前先分离该分子。|laboratory scientist molecule
inclusive|adj.|Allowing many kinds of people to take part.|包容的；允许不同人群参与的。|An inclusive classroom helps every student feel welcome.|包容的课堂让每个学生都感到被接纳。|students classroom group
reshape|v.|To change the form or character of something.|重塑；改变形态或性质。|New technology may reshape the way people work.|新技术可能重塑人们的工作方式。|modern office technology
immigrant|n.|A person who comes to live in another country.|移民；到另一个国家定居的人。|The immigrant opened a small shop in her new neighborhood.|这位移民在她的新社区开了一家小店。|neighborhood grocery shop
thrive|v.|To grow, develop, or succeed strongly.|繁荣；茁壮成长；发展良好。|Small businesses thrive when local demand grows.|当地需求增长时，小企业会蓬勃发展。|busy local market
prone|adj.|Likely to suffer from or do something undesirable.|易于遭受或做出某种不利行为的。|People are prone to mistakes when they rush.|人们匆忙时容易犯错。|person work desk
impulse|n.|A sudden desire to do something.|冲动；突然产生的行动欲望。|She resisted the impulse to buy another pair of shoes.|她克制了再买一双鞋的冲动。|shoe shop window
corporate|adj.|Related to a company or a group of companies.|公司的；企业的。|The report examines corporate responsibility for pollution.|这份报告探讨了企业对污染应承担的责任。|factory environment
binding|adj.|Creating an obligation that must be followed.|有约束力的；使人必须遵守的。|The agreement becomes binding after both sides sign it.|双方签字后，该协议便具有约束力。|signing contract desk
widow|n.|A woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried.|寡妇；配偶去世后尚未再婚的女性。|The widow continued to manage the family business.|这位寡妇继续经营家族生意。|woman small business
emerge|v.|To become visible or known.|出现；开始显现或被认知。|A clearer picture began to emerge from the evidence.|随着证据出现，事情逐渐变得清晰。|research documents desk
lag|v.|To move or develop more slowly than someone or something.|落后；进展更慢。|Rural internet access may lag behind that of cities.|农村的互联网接入可能落后于城市。|rural village computer
grant|n.|Money given for a particular purpose, often study or research.|拨款；常用于学习或研究的资助。|The student received a grant to continue her research.|这位学生获得了一笔资助，以继续研究。|university laboratory student

lingua franca|n.|A language used by people with different first languages.|通用语；不同母语的人之间使用的共同语言。|English often serves as a lingua franca at international meetings.|在国际会议上，英语常用作通用语。|international conference meeting
allegiance|n.|Loyalty to a person, organization, or belief.|忠诚；对个人、组织或信念的拥护。|Their allegiance to the organization remained strong.|他们对该组织仍然十分忠诚。|team people group
decent|adj.|Good enough in quality or standard.|相当好的；达到合适标准的。|Everyone deserves a decent place to live.|每个人都应有一个条件不错的住所。|apartment housing
overlook|v.|To fail to notice or consider something.|忽略；没有注意或考虑到。|Do not overlook the small details in the report.|不要忽略报告中的小细节。|person reading report
coding|n.|The activity of writing instructions for computers.|编程；为计算机编写指令的活动。|The school introduced coding to help students solve problems.|学校引入编程，帮助学生解决问题。|students computer classroom
essential|adj.|Completely necessary for something.|必不可少的；至关重要的。|Regular practice is essential for lasting improvement.|规律练习对于持续进步至关重要。|student studying notebook
collaboration|n.|The process of working together toward a shared goal.|合作；为共同目标一起工作的过程。|The project succeeded through close collaboration between teams.|项目通过团队之间的密切合作取得了成功。|team meeting collaboration
habitat|n.|The natural place where a plant or animal lives.|栖息地；动植物自然生活的环境。|Protecting the wetland helps preserve the birds' habitat.|保护湿地有助于保留鸟类的栖息地。|wetland birds habitat

immersive|adj.|Making someone feel deeply involved in an experience.|沉浸式的；使人深入投入某种体验的。|The museum created an immersive exhibition about ancient cities.|博物馆打造了一个关于古代城市的沉浸式展览。|museum immersive exhibition
thorny|adj.|Difficult and complicated to deal with.|棘手的；难以处理且复杂的。|The committee must address several thorny questions.|委员会必须处理几个棘手的问题。|committee meeting discussion
backdrop|n.|The setting or background against which something happens.|背景；事件发生的环境。|The debate took place against a backdrop of economic uncertainty.|这场辩论是在经济不确定的背景下展开的。|public debate meeting
converge|v.|To move toward the same point or become more similar.|汇聚；趋于一致。|The two teams' ideas began to converge after the discussion.|讨论后，两个团队的想法开始趋于一致。|team discussion table
ethos|n.|The shared values and spirit of a group.|精神特质；群体共同的价值观与理念。|Fair play is central to the ethos of the sports club.|公平竞争是这家体育俱乐部理念的核心。|sports team handshake
staff|v.|To provide an organization with workers.|为某个组织配备工作人员。|Volunteers staff the information desk during the event.|活动期间，志愿者在咨询台工作。|volunteer information desk
blunder|n.|A serious mistake caused by carelessness or poor judgment.|大错；因粗心或判断不当造成的错误。|Ignoring the warning was a costly blunder.|忽视警告是一个代价高昂的错误。|warning sign
inherent|adj.|Existing as a basic part of something.|固有的；内在的。|Every investment carries an inherent risk.|每项投资都带有内在风险。|finance documents chart
wildfire|n.|A large uncontrolled fire in a natural area.|野火；自然区域内失控的大火。|The wildfire spread quickly through the dry forest.|野火在干燥的森林中迅速蔓延。|forest wildfire
landscape|n.|The visible natural features of an area.|地貌；一个地区可见的自然景观。|The river has shaped the landscape over many years.|多年来，这条河流塑造了当地的地貌。|river valley landscape
justify|v.|To give a good reason for an action or belief.|证明有道理；为行为或观点提供合理理由。|The evidence does not justify such a strong conclusion.|这些证据不足以支持如此强烈的结论。|research report desk
evaporate|v.|To disappear gradually, or turn from liquid into gas.|逐渐消失；或由液体变成气体。|Their hopes began to evaporate as costs increased.|随着成本增加，他们的希望开始逐渐消失。|empty business office
hasten|v.|To make an event happen sooner.|加速；促使事情更早发生。|The new policy may hasten the transition to clean energy.|新政策可能加速向清洁能源的转型。|solar panels wind turbines
drought|n.|A long period with little or no rain.|干旱；长时间缺少降雨的时期。|The drought reduced the region's food production.|干旱使该地区的粮食产量下降。|dry farmland drought
attuned|adj.|Sensitive to or aware of something.|敏锐的；对某事有所意识并能作出响应的。|Good teachers are attuned to their students' needs.|好的教师对学生的需求很敏锐。|teacher classroom student
identify|v.|To recognize or establish what something is.|识别；确定某物是什么。|The study aims to identify the causes of the problem.|这项研究旨在找出问题的原因。|scientist research laboratory
recruit|v.|To find and employ new people.|招募；聘用新的人员。|The company plans to recruit more engineers this year.|公司计划今年招聘更多工程师。|job interview office
principally|adv.|Mainly; more than anything else.|主要地；以某种因素为主。|The program is funded principally by local donations.|这个项目主要由当地捐款资助。|community donation volunteers
inhabit|v.|To live in or occupy a place.|居住于；占据某个地方。|Several rare species inhabit this forest.|几种珍稀物种栖息在这片森林中。|forest wildlife
underlying|adj.|Existing beneath the surface and helping explain something.|根本的；潜在的；表面现象背后的。|The report explores the underlying causes of inequality.|报告探讨了不平等背后的根本原因。|social research documents
reskilling|n.|Learning new skills so that one can do a different kind of work.|再培训；为从事不同工作而学习新技能。|Reskilling can help workers adapt to technological change.|再培训可以帮助劳动者适应技术变化。|adult computer training
requirement|n.|Something that is needed or must be done.|要求；必须满足的必要条件。|Work experience is a requirement for this position.|工作经验是这个岗位的必要条件。|job application documents
forecast|v.|To predict what is likely to happen.|预测；预报可能发生的事情。|Analysts forecast a rise in demand next year.|分析人士预测明年需求会增长。|business forecast chart
dominate|v.|To have the greatest power or influence in a situation.|主导；占据支配或统治地位。|A few large firms dominate the market.|少数几家大型企业主导着市场。|city business buildings
roam|v.|To move around freely without a fixed destination.|漫步；没有固定目的地地自由走动。|Visitors can roam through the gardens at their own pace.|游客可以按自己的节奏在花园里漫步。|people walking garden
dismiss|v.|To refuse to consider an idea as important or reasonable.|不屑一顾；拒绝认真考虑某个观点。|We should not dismiss the concerns of local residents.|我们不应对当地居民的担忧不屑一顾。|community residents meeting
retirement|n.|The time or state of stopping regular work, usually because of age.|退休；通常因年龄而停止日常工作的阶段。|She plans to travel after retirement.|她计划退休后去旅行。|older person travel
workforce|n.|All the people available for or employed in work.|劳动力；可工作或受雇工作的全部人员。|The company is investing in training its workforce.|公司正在投入资金培训员工队伍。|workers factory training
encounter|v.|To meet someone or experience a difficulty unexpectedly.|遇到；意外碰到某人或困难。|New users may encounter problems with the complex menu.|新用户可能会在复杂菜单上遇到问题。|person computer screen
intuitive|adj.|Easy to understand or use without much instruction.|直观的；无需大量说明就容易理解或使用的。|An intuitive design makes the app easier to use.|直观的设计让这个应用更容易使用。|mobile app interface
quest|n.|A long or determined search for something.|追求；对某物持续或坚定的探寻。|The quest for cleaner energy requires cooperation.|寻求更清洁的能源需要合作。|solar energy research
greenwash|n.|A misleading appearance of environmental responsibility.|环保幌子；虚假的环保形象。|The report questions whether the campaign is merely greenwash.|报告质疑这场宣传是否只是环保幌子。|factory green environment
launch|v.|To introduce a product or service to the market.|推出；将产品或服务投放市场。|The company will launch a new learning platform next month.|公司将在下个月推出新的学习平台。|product launch event
maintenance|n.|Work done to keep something in good condition.|维护；保养；使某物保持良好状态的工作。|Regular maintenance keeps the equipment working safely.|定期维护能确保设备安全运行。|technician machine maintenance
lead|v.|To direct a group or guide an activity.|领导；指挥；引导某项活动。|She will lead the team through the difficult project.|她将带领团队完成这个困难的项目。|team leader meeting
lead|n.|A heavy soft grey metal, pronounced differently from the verb.|铅；一种柔软的灰色重金属，读音与动词不同。|Old pipes sometimes contain lead.|旧管道有时含铅。|lead metal cube
